title: Allah Ho Akbar Hy Mera Sona Akbar
body:
Dai Aakhri Putar Azaan (x2) Howai Deen Toun Aj Qurbaan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Par Putar Ashaadan Laillah Hai Tera Istakbaal Kaza (x2)
Ay Hurab Di Haii Manshaa, Chand Ghariyaan Da Mehmaan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sab Dayn Gawaii Arz-o-sama Mera Nana Paak Rasullallah (x2)
Aayii Rondi Maan Zahra, Teri Bachra Sun Azaan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaho Heya Ala Kairal Amal, Asa Piyu Putar-a-nai Hona Katil (x2)
Naii Karni Ummat Haya, Mun Khaliq Da Farmaan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Mera Baba Imamul Mutaqeen, Terai Lah Unal Honiay Surkh Zameen (x2)
Piya Qambda-e-karbobla, Tera Katil Da Sun Aylaan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Aa Ibrahim Khalillullah, Hona Akbar Barchi Naal Zibah (x2)
Akiyaan Tu Patiya Laa, Nai Barchi Kichan-e-Asaan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Honda Putar Akihyaan Da Noor Akbar, Ai Ha Jag Da Haii Das Toor Akbar (x2)
Nahi Jiiundai Piyu Bachra, Jadoun Marday Putar Jawaan.
